strings.en: Please take them out in one shot so they can't strike back!
Considering repair costs, I'd rather not fight...!
Do you have any idea what one of these battleships costs!?
Well, well... truly a desperate situation.
How uneconomical... Can't you endure it somehow!?
The enemy's quite good. Financially speaking, it's a headache...!
You really must dodge properly, you know...
Ooh, just what you'd expect from girls these days.
The field is only buying us time now, I see.
Captain, missiles really aren't all that cheap, you know...
The enemy has thought this through...
They fell right into our trap!
Considering repair costs, I can't let that happen!
Ignite all missiles at once, I take it.
